summary: Comprehensive architectural and UI/UX implementation plan for Litdom Batch Studio, aligning the entire design with the 20-page reference mockups in IMG_1495 (2).pdf and the 115-page Master Application Brief. Covers the golden-yellow visual theme, the 3 independent workflows (Document DOCX 27-style OpenXML pipeline, Image batch layout, and Spreadsheet template population), universal editor with dynamic bottom dock swapping, top bar navigation with horizontal thumbnail drawer, modal sheets (Download with CMYK PDF settings, Social Share, Sync Layout, Add elements, More menu), and dual-level text editing.
